squidgame.game.dalgona.board:
CARVE THE SHAPE - DO NOT CRACK THE COOKIE

Free: %s   Lost: %s   Contestants: %s
squidgame.game.dalgona.detail: %s cookies cracked, %s contestants ran out of time.
squidgame.game.dalgona.headline: %s cookies came free
squidgame.game.dalgona.instruction.1: Each contestant sits at a desk with four closed honeycomb tins. Pick one: what is inside is pure luck - a circle, a triangle, a star or the dreaded umbrella.
squidgame.game.dalgona.instruction.2: Carve the shape out of the cookie with the needle: hold the left mouse button and trace the groove. The shape is free once enough of the line is carved.
squidgame.game.dalgona.instruction.3: Go slowly and stay on the line. A fast or wandering needle raises the cookie's stress, thin tips and corners are the most fragile spots, and at 100 the cookie cracks - a cracked cookie means elimination.
squidgame.game.dalgona.instruction.4: Right mouse button or L: lick the cookie. The warm sugar softens and the stress drops. You have %s licks and each needs a moment before the next.
squidgame.game.dalgona.instruction.5: You have %s seconds, tin selection included. The shape is free at %s%% of the line carved. Anyone whose cookie is not free when time runs out is eliminated.
squidgame.game.dalgona.instruction.6: If you close the carving table with Esc the clock keeps running: right-click your desk to reopen it. Difficulty: %s.

squidgame.game.dalgona.screen.help.2: Right click / L: lick   Esc: step away (clock runs)
squidgame.game.dalgona.screen.hint.lick: Stress is rising - right click or press L to lick and cool the cookie
Right click / L: lick to cool it down

squidgame.game.dalgona.screen.tip.lick.2: Cools the cookie by %s. The needle locks briefly.
squidgame.game.dalgona.screen.tip.lick.3: Limited licks, with a pause between them.
squidgame.game.dalgona.screen.tip.stress: Fast, shaky or off-line carving adds stress.
At 100 it cracks. Rest or lick to cool it.

squidgame.game.marbles.headline: %s contestants won their match
squidgame.game.marbles.instruction.1: First find a partner: right-click another contestant and ask. You have %s s; whoever is still alone when the time is up is paired at random (with an odd number, one contestant gets a bye and is safe).
squidgame.game.marbles.instruction.2: Every pair goes to its own plot and plays for each other's marbles. Everybody starts with %s marbles.
squidgame.game.marbles.instruction.mixed: Each pair plays one of the two games; you find out when you reach your plot.
squidgame.game.marbles.instruction.oddev: ODD OR EVEN: the holder secretly hides 1 or more of their marbles in a fist. The guesser wagers marbles (at most what both own) and calls odd or even.
A right call wins the wager, a wrong call gives it to the holder. Both decide at the same time and the roles swap every round. Winning needs reading your opponent.
squidgame.game.marbles.instruction.out: Whoever loses all marbles - or owns fewer when time runs out - is eliminated. A tie is settled by one more round. Difficulty: %s.
squidgame.game.marbles.instruction.throw: TARGET THROW: take turns throwing a marble at the bullseye. Look at the spot where it should land, hold the use key to charge and release in the green zone of the power bar - and stay behind the line.
The marble that rests closer to the middle wins marbles from the other: 1, plus 1 for every two points of difference between the rings, at most %s.

squidgame.game.red_light.detail: Everyone who did not make it was eliminated.
squidgame.game.red_light.headline: %s contestants crossed the line
squidgame.game.red_light.instruction.1: Cross the playground and reach the finish line before time runs out.
squidgame.game.red_light.instruction.2: While the giant doll chants with her back turned (GREEN LIGHT) you may run.
squidgame.game.red_light.instruction.3: When the chant ends she turns around. You have a stopping allowance of %s s to stop.
squidgame.game.red_light.instruction.4: When her eyes light up (RED LIGHT) any movement you cause - walking, running, jumping - eliminates you. Turning the camera is fine.
squidgame.game.red_light.instruction.5: If you are pushed or knocked back you are safe, as long as you are not pressing a movement key.
squidgame.game.red_light.instruction.6: Anyone who has not crossed the line when time runs out is eliminated. Difficulty: %s.

squidgame.game.tug_of_war.headline: %s contestants survived the tug of war
squidgame.game.tug_of_war.instruction.1: Two teams pull a rope across a pit. The team whose end is pulled over the edge falls and is eliminated; the winners survive.
squidgame.game.tug_of_war.instruction.2: Hold [%s] to pull: it drains your stamina, release it to recover. An exhausted contestant can only brace until their strength is back.
squidgame.game.tug_of_war.instruction.3: Hold [%s] to brace: leaning back anchors your team against being dragged and costs far less stamina than pulling.
squidgame.game.tug_of_war.instruction.4: Tap [%s] exactly on the beat (watch the ring): a well-timed heave is a burst of force, and the more of your team heaves together the stronger every burst. Mistimed heaves only cost stamina.
squidgame.game.tug_of_war.instruction.5: Pace yourself: a team that burns its stamina early loses late. If time runs out the rope position decides; a dead tie goes to a sudden death.
squidgame.game.tug_of_war.instruction.6: A heat lasts %s s. Difficulty: %s. With more than 64 contestants the field pulls in several heats.
